name: Jane Example

jobs.title: Operations Manager
bullets: Led a team of 12 across two warehouses and cut order-to-delivery time by 30% by redesigning the dispatch process.
Renegotiated carrier contracts with 8 vendors, saving 18% on annual transport cost.
Introduced weekly KPI reviews with department heads; on-time delivery rose from 88% to 97%.
Managed a 1.2M annual budget and reported monthly to the executive team.

jobs.title: Project Manager
bullets: Delivered 14 store-opening projects on time and within budget, coordinating contractors, suppliers and local authorities.
Built the project plan template and risk register adopted by all regional teams.
Ran a cross-functional steering group of 7 stakeholders and escalated blockers within 24 hours.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Analysed sales and inventory data for 5 clients and recommended process changes that improved margins by 4%.
Wrote requirement documents and trained 20 client staff on a new reporting tool.

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative
bullets: Handled 60+ customer contacts a day with a 95% satisfaction score.

jobs.title: Self-built tools and automations
bullets: Built a Python script that merges weekly supplier reports into one dashboard, saving about 3 hours a week.
Maintain a small web app for tracking household budgets (HTML, JavaScript, SQLite).

jobs.title: Graduate Research Assistant (Economics)
bullets: Co-authored a conference paper on regional supply-chain resilience.
Collected and cleaned survey data from 300 firms.

notes_for_tailoring: Jane is an operations and project manager. For operations roles lead with delivery, cost and team results; for project roles lead with delivery on time and budget. Never claim software engineering experience or certifications that are not listed.
